title: Supplier spend concentration requires commercial review
management_question: Where does supplier concentration create dependency or negotiating exposure?
rationale: 6 material signal(s) across SUP-01, SUP-03 support one management theme. Related signals are compressed without deleting their underlying evidence.
next_step: Review critical suppliers, alternatives, contract terms and operational substitutability before assigning risk value.
limitation: No causal or monetised opportunity conclusion is created by management-attention selection.

supporting_evidence.core_question: Which suppliers does your business genuinely depend on, what profit or revenue is exposed if something changes, and where should you reduce risk or strengthen your commercial position?
supporting_evidence.evidence_summary: Alloy Metals represents 13.67781155015197568389057751% of captured annual supplier spend. This is concentration exposure only; no disruption probability or expected loss is inferred.

recommended_actions.recommended_action: Review concentrated suppliers for criticality, alternatives, terms and negotiation opportunities.
recommended_actions.evidence_required: Contracts, item-level purchases/prices, alternative-source evidence and operational criticality.
recommended_actions.limitation: Recommended action is an investigation/intervention path, not proof of causality or benefit.

opportunities.recommended_action: Review concentrated suppliers for criticality, alternatives, terms and negotiation opportunities.
opportunities.evidence_required: Contracts, item-level purchases/prices, alternative-source evidence and operational criticality.
opportunities.limitation: No monetary opportunity is supported from this management priority without mechanism, addressability and recovery-envelope evidence.
